tree.heading: C–TPAT
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the United States Customs and Border Protection to carry out the provisions of sections 961 through 971 of this title to remain available until expended—

tree.heading: Additional personnel
tree.text: In addition to any amounts otherwise appropriated to the United States Customs and Border Protection, there are authorized to be appropriated for the purpose of meeting the staffing requirement provided for in section 972 of this title, to remain available until expended—

ancestors.heading: SECURITY AND ACCOUNTABILITY FOR EVERY PORT
SECURITY OF THE INTERNATIONAL SUPPLY CHAIN
